scope: Read-only audit of exact public-access outlet directory fields. No Mapbox or paid sources. No workbook edits.

sources_checked.evidence: VivoCity directory search result lists Shake Shack at unit #01-163 and displays contact number 8852 5873 as an image/alt-text in the More Info area. Listing is live/current in the directory crawl. Direct open returned 403; underlying directory page was not independently fetched in this session.
VivoCity states mall hours as daily 10am-10pm and customer service hotline 6377 6870. These are mall-level details, not outlet-specific, so neither was assigned to tenant records.
NEX confirms 4Fingers at #B2-50/51 and displays NEX mall hours 10:30am-10:30pm. Tenant-specific phone and hours are not listed; not used to fill outlet contact or hours.

field_deltas.address_match: 1 HARBOURFRONT WALK, VIVO CITY, SINGAPORE 098585; first-party directory identifies unit #01-163 (SFA address omits unit)
field_deltas.reason: Exact brand/venue match; official mall directory displays the number, but it appears as image alt-text and the page itself could not be opened directly (403). Recommend human/source-level confirmation before integration.

non_deltas.finding: VivoCity tenant listing confirms the outlet/unit remains listed. Mall publishes daily 10am-10pm, but this is mall-wide and not sufficient proof of outlet operating hours; no field change proposed.
NEX listing confirms the tenant and unit, but only mall-wide hours (Mon-Sun 10:30am-10:30pm) are stated. No outlet-hours field change proposed.
